summary: The truck in maintenance in August 2025 was a 2022 Kenworth W990 (Vehicle ID TRK-2167). It received preventive maintenance at 120,000 miles on August 20, including oil and filter changes, fuel filter replacement, and electrical repairs. A softening left front shock absorber was noted for future replacement. The service cost $1,381, and the truck was returned to service on August 21. The next maintenance is scheduled at 135,000 miles or within 90 days.
